native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'pot1': '0% (0)', 'pot2': '0% (0)', 'sevseg1': '0'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, the 7-segment display shows 0. Both potentiometers are at their minimum position (0% or value 0).'}

test2: {'time': 1.0, 'state': {'pot1': '100% (1023)', 'pot2': '0% (0)', 'sevseg1': '9'}, 'description': 'First potentiometer adjustment. Pot1 is moved to maximum (100% or value 1023), which maps to 9. Pot2 remains at 0. The sum is 9, so the display shows 9.'}

test3: {'time': 1.5, 'state': {'pot1': '100% (1023)', 'pot2': '100% (1023)', 'sevseg1': '8'}, 'description': 'Second potentiometer adjustment. Pot2 is also moved to maximum (100% or value 1023), which maps to 9. The sum is 18, but only the last digit (8) is displayed.'}

test4: {'time': 2.0, 'state': {'pot1': '0% (0)', 'pot2': '100% (1023)', 'sevseg1': '9'}, 'description': 'First potentiometer reset. Pot1 is moved back to minimum (0% or value 0), mapping to 0. Pot2 remains at maximum (9). The sum is 9, so the display shows 9.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
